author: FitnessFan2024
title: Subscription scam
content: Signed up for the free trial and was charged $79.99 immediately without any warning. There was no clear indication that the trial would auto-convert to a paid subscription. I want a refund immediately. This is misleading and unfair to users who just want to try the app.

author: Sarah_M
title: Charged without permission
content: I downloaded this app and within minutes I was charged for a yearly subscription. I never agreed to this. The cancellation process is hidden deep in the settings and I cannot get a refund. Apple should remove this app from the store.

author: JaneDoe
title: Great workouts but subscription is confusing
content: The workout routines are excellent and I have seen real results in 4 weeks. The trainers are motivating and the variety keeps me engaged. However, the subscription pricing is confusing and I accidentally paid for a year when I wanted monthly.

author: WorkoutLover
title: Crashes on iOS 17
content: The app crashes every time I try to start a workout on my iPhone 14 with iOS 17.2. I have reinstalled it twice but the issue persists. Please fix this asap because I love this app otherwise. The crash happens right after the countdown timer.

author: MariaG
title: Crashes after update
content: Worked fine until the latest update. Now it crashes on launch. I have paid for a subscription and cannot use the app at all. Very frustrating. Please roll back or fix immediately.

author: HappyUser123
title: Love this app
content: Best workout app for women! The low-impact workouts are perfect for my bad knees. The trainers explain everything clearly and the progress tracking keeps me motivated. I have been using it for 6 months and lost 15 pounds.

author: Disappointed_User
title: Cannot cancel subscription
content: I have been trying to cancel my subscription for weeks. The cancel button in the app settings does not work and redirects to a broken page. I had to go through Apple support to finally cancel. The company is clearly making it hard on purpose.

author: AnnaK
title: Good content, buggy app
content: The workout content is really good and the instructors are professional. But the app itself has many bugs - sometimes videos do not load, the progress tracker resets randomly, and notifications do not work. Needs serious technical improvements.

author: FitMom
title: Great for busy moms
content: As a working mom, the 15-minute workouts are perfect. I can squeeze them in during nap time. Would love to see more postpartum-specific workouts and a feature to track heart rate from Apple Watch. The meal plans are also helpful.

author: AngryCustomer
title: Hidden fees everywhere
content: First they charge you for the subscription, then every additional workout pack costs extra. There is no way to tell which workouts are included and which cost more. Total scam. I have spent over $100 and still cannot access half the content. Avoid this app.
